scripts.build:jvm: npm run build:native && mvn -f jvm/pom.xml verify
scripts.build: npm run metadata:verify && npm run build:plugin-sdk && npm run build:jvm && npm run build:desktop
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run components:stage && npm run package:dir -w @tanwei/desktop
scripts.package:test: npm run build && npm run components:stage && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run package:dir -w @tanwei/desktop

scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run package:test && npm run test:e2e
